svg.title: Tusk ACT 1 → Tusk ACT 2 → Tusk ACT 3 → Tusk ACT 4
svg.desc: Spinning fingernails fired like bullets. The bullet holes move, and they chase their target. Shoots itself to hide inside its own spinning holes. Infinite rotation, born from the Golden Spin on horseback. Nothing escapes it.
